summaries.zh: 用 deepseek-harness 的创造模式做的小桌宠插件，每次对话随机出现名字，听说抽到梁神有特殊效果哦/The small table pet plugin made with the deepseek-harness creation mode randomly shows names in each conversation. It's said that drawing Liang Shen has a special effect
